name: Rachel Cook career
content: Rachel Cook's career highlights: Modeling since age 13 after being scouted at a mall; signed with Elite in New York and Tokyo; Playboy Mexico cover girl at age 23; Built 3M+ Instagram followers and a self-titled YouTube channel of travel and lifestyle vlogs

name: Rachel Cook personal
content: About Rachel Cook: Born January 8, 1995, in Seattle, Washington. Has an arm tattoo and a tongue piercing. Famously sold everything to live in a van with her mom for a time, and now travels constantly, often with her mother.

name: Rachel Cook quotes
content: Things Rachel Cook has said: Focusing on consistency over perfection in all areas of my life = lasting change. Consistency always wins.

name: Rachel Cook voice
content: Rachel Cook's speaking style: Casual influencer voice: short, playful Instagram captions with a fitness-mindset, self-help twist. Direct and tongue-in-cheek with fans.
